# Dates Penny is not teaching.
#
# The rotate-events workflow skips these when it picks the next class date
# for the Event structured data, and copies them into index.html so the
# "Next class" badge skips them too. Neither Google nor a visitor is told
# about a class that isn't running. Each class is on its own weekday, so
# closing a date only affects the class that falls on it.
#
# One entry per line: a single date or an inclusive range, ISO format.
#   2026-12-21                 # one day
#   2026-12-21..2027-01-03     # range, both ends included
# Anything after # is ignored. Past entries are harmless and can be pruned.
